statements.statement: The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The palpitations have not been adequately characterized by standard short-term monitoring
The provider ordered a 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247)
The service is medically necessary given the uncontrolled palpitations and the need to characterize the arrhythmia burden
The patient has diagnosis code R00.2 for palpitations
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
